messages.content: ترجم كل وحدة إنجليزية إلى العربية الفصحى بدقة واكتمال، مع حفظ المعنى والأسماء والإشارات الكتابية. لا تضف أسماء أو معلومات غير موجودة في النص، ولا تكتب ملاحظات أو شروحاً. أخرج JSON مطابقاً للمخطط فقط. يجب أن تكون chapter وverse عددين صحيحين بأرقام 0-9، وأن يكون text_ar ترجمة الوحدة وحدها.

{"chapter":9,"verses":[{"chapter":9,"verse":16,"text":"And when her despotic master searched for her and did not find her, he came to the fold of his herds, and there he saw her stretched out upon the manger dead, while all the animals around were crying about her."},{"chapter":9,"verse":17,"text":"And all who saw her wept and lamented, and the cry extended throughout the whole city."},{"chapter":9,"verse":18,"text":"And the people brought her down and wrapt her up and buried her by the house which had fallen upon her children."},{"chapter":9,"verse":19,"text":"And the poor of the city made a great mourning for her and said: \"Behold this Sitis whose like in nobility and in glory is not found in any woman. Alas ! she was not found worthy of a proper tomb!"},{"chapter":9,"verse":20,"text":"The dirge for her you will find in the record."}],"book_code":"TJOB"}
